name: While Loop Pattern
description: Iterative processing with While loop node (supports forEach mode)
explanation:
Pattern for iterative processing with While loop.

Loop Modes:
1. while (condition-based):
   - conditionMode: simple/builder/code
   - conditionField: Field to evaluate
   - conditionOperator: ==, !=, >, <, etc.
   - conditionValue: Expected value

2. forEach (array iteration):
   - loopMode: 'forEach'
   - forEachSource: Array path (e.g., 'imapResult.emails')
   - forEachItemVar: Item variable name (e.g., 'currentEmail')
   - Access item: {{context.currentEmail}}
   - Access index: {{context.currentIndex}}
   - Access total: {{context.totalCount}}

Common settings:
- maxIterations: Safety limit (default: 10)
- showTools: true (enable loop tools area)

Loop Tools (inside While):
- AI, Data Sheets, Wait, If/Else, Continue, IMAP, SMTP
- Connect from While's 'loop' handle
- loopOrder determines execution sequence
